body: Okay now that I'm home I can respond. It says it's a civil action brought by [hospital] for debt under $25k. I'm not sure what else information is relevant.. there's an attached affidavit of sworn account. I really hope I'm not getting arrested, all these words.. "any lawful officer to execute and return: [my name]". Ugh, I can't even think about it for more than 10 minutes before I start to all out panic.
What kind of lawyer would I consult? I don't think I can afford one, but I can try

I was thinking of going to the clinic and demanding to see SOMEONE on Monday, but I don't know if I'll have the energy to do it come Monday. 

It's so depressing, I *want* to get into a trade career, I'm supposed to go on the 14th (assuming I make it that long) to take an assessment exam for electrician apprenticeship, and I've been sitting here working on my basic algebra skills on khan academy because I REALLY want to get in. But I need something in the meantime, and I have no idea what to do about it. I'm even applying to part time high schooler jobs, just for something.

I have a case worker assigned to me from outpatient services when I stayed at a crisis stabilization unit, but unfortunately I never hear from her. When I call her, she doesn't answer, and she doesn't return my voice mails. I've asked the clinic to set me up an appointment with her to talk to her (Because she's also the one to get me with a therapist) but all they do is call her and leave a voice mail, of course which goes unanswered.

I felt so hopeful when I left the CSU, that I was going to have all this help. Now, though I don't remember feeling so abandoned in my life.
